name: Whelgar's Excavation Site
summary: Dwarven prospectors are trapped above Whelgar's Excavation Site, cut off from their findings. The dig sought ancient Titan relics, prehistoric secrets, and fossils, but mottled raptors overran the quarry.

sections.title: A Ruined Expedition
sections.body: Between Menethil Harbor and Dun Modr, dwarven prospectors dug for ancient fossils and earthen mysteries. Their search for prehistoric remnants stirred the native mottled raptors. Overwhelmed and under-equipped, the archaeologists fled to a ridge overlooking the site. Their tents, tools, and unearthed relics remain scattered among the prowling predators.

faq.q: Why was the excavation site abandoned?
faq.answer: The dwarven excavators disturbed the territory of aggressive mottled raptors. Overwhelmed by the ferocious creatures, the surviving crew took refuge on a ridge overlooking the dig site.

faq.q: What were the dwarves looking for here?
faq.answer: The dwarves sought prehistoric fossils and subterranean artifacts, hoping to uncover ancient clues about their Titan heritage and the world's distant past.

faq.q: What threats roam the digsite now?
aliases: what is in the excavation site
faq.answer: Mottled raptors swarm the quarry floor and surrounding ridges, including the feared Sarltooth.

faq.q: Where did the surviving excavators go?
faq.answer: The surviving crew, including Prospector Whelgar, are trapped atop a ridge overlooking the dig site. They seek brave adventurers to recover their lost research.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing a dig abandoned to feral beasts is an insult to the Explorers' League. Reclaiming Whelgar's research means defending your heritage and recovering stolen Titan secrets.
The quarry's exposed walls and unearthed bedrock offer prime veins for miners daring enough to work beneath hungry raptors' snarls.
